question: Does the only untested one-dimensional C4 landing irrep, the charge-two alternating response, close the width-four affine/Gram/source intersection by itself?

scope.ordinary_module: V_4 is the fourteen-dimensional circular noncrossing connectivity module
scope.mark_module: L_2 is one-dimensional with quarter-turn character -1
scope.only_case: No charge-one combination, extra scalar mark, free endpoint column or further width is tested.

charge2_semantics.landing_positions: lambda_i labels the complementary three-site landing registry opposite source site i
charge2_semantics.provenance: This is the remaining C4 irrep in the four-position landing permutation after the scalar and charge-one sectors already tested.

generic_Q_action.mark_emission: E_i(pi)=(-1)^i when site i is singleton and zero otherwise
generic_Q_action.marked_detach: D_bar_i1 has P_i in the ordinary block and E_i in the charge-two-by-ordinary row

gram.landing_reference_states: tau_i has site i singleton and the complementary three sites joined
gram.compatibility: For radical basis B require B^T(G_bar1 X0-X0^T G_bar1)B=0
gram.non_scalar_gate: C_2(1) must add rank outside the complete width-four falling-factorial scalar block-count span

normalization.filtration: X0 and V do not feed L_2 back into V_4
normalization.endpoint: U=(one^T,0) is fixed by X0 and annihilates V
normalization.ordinary_source: The all-singleton source is fixed by X0 and killed by V
normalization.landing_transport: X0 restricted to L_2 is -1 and V restricted to L_2 is zero

analysis_ladder: plus endpoint normalization and radical invariance
plus ordinary-source and charge-two transport normalization

decision_rule.minimal_closed_unique: The final system is consistent with tangent dimension zero.
decision_rule.minimal_closed_nonunique: The final system is consistent with positive tangent dimension.
decision_rule.failure_consequence: Scalar, C4 charge-one and C4 charge-two endpoint irreps have then all failed individually. Any next construction must change from terminal endpoint marks to retained rooted/landing connectivity or a coupled multi-irrep registry; no further case is run here.

outputs.dimensions: Exact affine tangent dimension or inconsistency at each gate
outputs.non_scalar: Exact rank beyond scalar columns and translation covariance
outputs.failure: First left-null inconsistency witness and exhausted-irrep statement

claim_boundary: Exact rational Q=1 first-jet algebra at width four only.
The single mark is the fixed C4 charge-two landing character, not a fitted endpoint column.
Success would identify a minimal closed finite-width module only; it would not identify an LCFT field or physical transfer matrix.
